title: Oven Roasted Turkish Cheese Kunefe
description: A traditional Turkish dessert featuring melted cheese and crispy phyllo, now adapted to be sugar-free friendly and made with dry white wine, perfect for meal prep. This jammy and velvety kunefe is a unique twist on the classic recipe.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Layer the phyllo dough in a large baking dish, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Mix the cheese, dum, and beaten eggs in a bowl until well combined.
Pour the cheese mixture over the phyllo dough, making sure to cover the entire surface.
Drizzle the dry white wine over the cheese mixture.
Bake the kunefe in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove the kunefe from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the kunefe warm, garnished with a sprinkle of salt and a side of fresh fruit if desired.
